# Cluster compatibility fixtures

The reports and candidate records come from `cluster.py` at commit `4d4a3c0b6bf4f74e9fa5d7b214b24bad5c0ec864`.
All inputs are synthetic. The report date is fixed for exact comparison.
Cases cover default thresholds and tied group ordering. They also cover connected groups and coverage boundaries.
The source filenames include Chinese text. The connected case exercises the twelve-source display limit.
